Enum Class Resource

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Resource>
org.ether.society.model.Resource
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Resource>, Constable
public enum Resource extends Enum<Resource>
Represents a natural resource in the simulation. Resources can be renewable (regenerate over time) or non-renewable (finite).
